primarySources.contract: Edition and volume are separate supplied metadata roles. The renderer adds its own edition/volume presentation. Edition values ending in ed. or Edição receive the extra-text maintenance category. These repairs retain the supplied number and the remaining volume payload; they do not claim byte-identical original rendering.

The exact accepted Edition and Volume aliases remain distinct from publication, page, title and person roles. Competing aliases, including blank values, are not discarded or resolved by this contract.

editionGrammar: Exactly one native Edition role, supplied under edição or Edição, with a complete decimal number, an optional English/Portuguese ordinal suffix and one complete ed., edition or edição label. Only the supplied number becomes the target value.
volumeGrammar: Exactly one native Volume role supplied under volume. A leading v. or vol. before a decimal digit is removed. Every following payload character remains; markup, newlines and competing native volume aliases refuse this independent projection.
classification: source-bound declared formatting repair; original rendering is not claimed equivalent
binding: The complete typed target citation, including title, URL, identifier, person roles, date, state fields and every other modeled field, must already exist in the actual output. A changed number or publication cannot borrow the repair.
